title: Orchestrator self-repo working tree is volatile during self-learning merges
summary: While editing ~/.claude/orchestrator/daemon.js, the concurrent self-learning harness (active git merges of orch/attempt/* branches, AUTO_MERGE present) transiently reset the main worktree to HEAD mid-session, briefly wiping the uncommitted embeddings/autowireNoteProvider daemon.js before restoring it. The orch-gate.sh hook is PreToolUse(Edit|Write) deny-only (exit 2) — it does NOT revert files; Bash `cp` is the supported write path and round-trips fine. Lesson: re-snapshot daemon.js to /tmp immediately before applying edits, cp+test in one atomic Bash step, and verify `diff -q /tmp live` held afterward, because a background merge can swap the file under you.
